summary:
Stale re-validation at ff666b0. Two things changed since my last pass at 9dad96a:
- **The uat merge (dadcc1b).** It brought in SL-071's src/FsAnalyser.Core changes (Scanner.cs, VolumeSpace.cs, Native/Kernel32.cs, ScanOptions/Progress/Result, TopLevelSnapshot/Tracker), TopLevelRowText.cs and Core.Tests.
- **Build attempt 6.** It is the backslashreplace step in Get-ImportRuleNames, plus an é/em-dash probe in Shape-ImportRuleNames.

These files are not in the 9dad96a..ff666b0 diff: eng/, .taad/fitness.yaml, ArchitectureRulesTests.cs, SettledCountProbe.ps1 and the acceptance repro.

**Everything I re-ran at HEAD passed:**
- Parity reads AGREE 11/15/27/49 under powershell.exe and pwsh.
- C-001 to C-005 exit 0 under both hosts (ok counts 8/34/26/26/230). C-006 and C-009 exit 0 with the engine under both hosts.
- C-007 on the real tree exits 0 under both hosts: 'xunit 11 Facts, 0 hits', 1 import rule named. The stray-violation bite names Scanner.cs, the file SL-071 changed.
- Sibling test `-Shape All` exits 0 in 598 s with 187 ok and 0 FAIL. GuardRule hits the pre-fix file at 35,240,243,305,326,370,408,600,625,633 and nothing in the current files.
- `-Shape ExpectFactsMismatch` alone exits 0 in 148 s ('found 11 … has 12' and 'found 12 … has 13', both shells). That is the named single-shape command O-009 asks for.
- `-Shape ImportRuleNames` with the engine exits 0: 9 import rules named on both hosts.
- `-Shape EngineCases` exits 0 in 512 s with 29 ok. C-007 and C-008 pass on this tree and on the 12/17/28 two-scope copy; C-008 expects 11/14/27/49 and 12/16/28/49.
- SettledCountProbe passes both shapes: on Misclassified, C-001 fails with 4 checks on the 14-twinned stub.
- Fitness holds (64 rules). The harness reports 48/48 AS-RECORDED with 0 stray hits. The merged tree passes 394/394 tests.
- I re-ran design case 14 on a scratch copy: parity CANNOT-READ at :195 [InlineData(1)], C-001 exits 1, C-007 exits 1 with harness CANNOT MEASURE.

**O-028 is fixed.** I checked independently of the builder's shape, on my own scratch copy with import rules named with é and with an em dash. The harness prints them as caf\xe9 and —, and C-007 names both.

**O-029 is confirmed and still open (owed to build-slice).** It sits on the same copy, as a `name: >` (folded, clip) import rule:
- yaml.safe_load gives the name a trailing '\n'.
- The harness prints that as '…Core\r\n' inside the NOT RUN line.
- C-007 exits 1 under both hosts with 'unnamed: the provider's folded-with-newline probe never imports Core'.

It is latent: the real yaml's only import rule is plain. It is the fifth finding in a row on the one comparison C-007 makes between yaml names and the harness's printed text, which is a loop:
- Build attempts 3–6 were each caused by code-review on that surface: O-025, then O-026/O-027, then O-028, now O-029.
- Attempts 5 and 6 changed no src.
- None of it touches the slice's deliverable, the recounted parity figures.

The structural close the builder named (the harness prints a JSON list of the names and C-007 compares lists) is still the thing a person should rank. Otherwise a sixth spelling patch follows.

**Assumptions.** The bug report is a title only. I took as acceptance:
- the engine's repro (exit 0 on record as O-001; the file is unchanged, so I did not re-run it);
- the slice's two statements;
- the C-003 lookahead that was cut as already built (found at line 332);
- the design's 14 cases.

The heading here is 'What this slice has to do, as the design fixed it', not 'What this slice owes', and it holds 14 items, more than `planned` can hold. So `planned` is empty and the 14 are graded under `criteria`.

**Hygiene.** My runs created 0 fsa-* folders in %TEMP% (1126 before and after). Both of my scratch folders are removed, and no testhost or dotnet process I started is still running. git status shows only the engine's .taad files.

criteria.criterion: Slice statement: RuleCases.ps1 derives the Facts/twinned/pattern counts instead of hard-coding them (about six sites plus the C-005 fixture)
criteria.how: At ff666b0, -Shape All GuardRule hits all 10 pre-fix literal lines and 0 lines in the current RuleCases.ps1 or either SL-069 test. SettledCountProbe Misclassified still exits 0, so the counts are recounted, not read back from the tool. Fitness op=check holds.

criteria.criterion: Slice statement: a slice that declares one more twinned rule leaves the rule-copy cases green
criteria.how: In -Shape All, SingleScope (12/16/28) and TwoScope (12/17/28) held C-001/3/4/5 on both hosts. EngineCases held C-007 and C-008 on the 12/17/28 copy. The engine repro's exit 0 is on record (O-001), and the file is unchanged.

criteria.criterion: C-003 lookahead narrowed to (?=^  - name:|^  # settled by SL-) (cut as already built)
criteria.how: Present at RuleCases.ps1:332. C-003 passes on the real tree under both hosts and inside SingleScope, TwoScope and C003Settled.

criteria.how: SingleScope in -Shape All: C-001 'All checks held.' under powershell.exe and pwsh, expecting 12/16/28/49.

criteria.criterion: Design 2: C-001, C-003, C-004, C-005 on a two-scope rule (Facts +1, Twinned +2)
criteria.how: TwoScope in -Shape All: all four hold under both hosts at 12/17/28 (C-003 with settled 50). EngineCases confirms the copy AGREEs at 12/17/28/49.

criteria.criterion: Design 3: C-005 deliberate -ExpectFacts mismatch on N and N+1 Facts
criteria.how: `-Shape ExpectFactsMismatch` alone exits 0: 'found 11 … has 12' on the unchanged copy and 'found 12 … has 13' on the grown copy, both exit 2 CANNOT-READ under both inner hosts.

criteria.criterion: Design 4: C-003 twin of a one-scope Fact deleted, added entry last above the marker, settled +1
criteria.how: C003Settled in -Shape All: C-003 holds under both hosts, and the appended row expects 12/16/28 with 50 settled.

criteria.criterion: Design 5: C-008 tests-scope entry deleted gives Twinned-1, other counts unchanged
criteria.how: EngineCases with the real engine: 'deleted from yaml' gives 11/14/27/49 on this tree and 12/16/28/49 on the two-scope copy. 'Dropped from xUnit' keeps 11/15/27/49 and 12/17/28/49. Both hosts.

criteria.criterion: Design 6: Get-RuleCounts on a yaml with several settled markers (SL-069's last)
criteria.how: SettledMarkers in -Shape All: C-001 holds on an unchanged copy (11/15/27/49) and on a copy with one more marker and entry (settled 50, twinned still 15), under both hosts.

criteria.criterion: Design 7: Get-RuleCounts with no settled marker
criteria.how: The NoMarker shape ran in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows. C-001 stops by name before any parity run, and C-002 still runs.

criteria.criterion: Design 8: Get-RuleCounts with the .cs missing, zero [Fact], or zero pattern lines
criteria.how: UnreadableCs (three variants) ran in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows. The missing-.cs variant prints 'C-001 stopped: RuleCounts: no …ArchitectureRulesTests.cs' and never says 'the repo ['.

criteria.criterion: Design 9: C-001 catches a miscounting parity tool (Misclassified)
criteria.how: SettledCountProbe -Shape Misclassified exits 0 at ff666b0. C-001 fails with 4 checks on the 14-twinned stub on both hosts.

criteria.criterion: Design 10: C-001 with a Fact the parity reader cannot see
criteria.how: UnseenFact in -Shape All: 0 FAIL rows under both hosts.

criteria.criterion: Design 11: host parity powershell.exe 5.1 and pwsh 7
criteria.how: Every case above ran under both hosts with identical outcomes. The HostParity shape (two-scope tree behind BOMs) ran in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows.

criteria.criterion: Design 12: literal-count guard rule fires on HEAD-before-fix and not on the fixed file
criteria.how: GuardRule hit lines 35,240,243,305,326,370,408,600,625,633 of the pinned pre-fix file and nothing in the current files, comments included. SettledCountProbe -Shape GuardRule also exits 0.

criteria.criterion: Design 13: Get-RuleCounts reading a yaml and .cs with a UTF-8 BOM
criteria.how: HostParity puts a BOM on both files, and it ran in -Shape All with 0 FAIL rows under both hosts. I did not extract its per-row counts separately this time.

criteria.criterion: Design 14: C-007 'xunit N Facts' when the test class holds a [Theory] with several data rows
criteria.how: Re-run at ff666b0 on a scratch copy: parity CANNOT-READ at :195 [InlineData(1)], C-001 exits 1, and C-007 exits 1 with harness CANNOT MEASURE. It fails loudly and never over-counts trx rows.

obligations.evidence: Named single-shape command `pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tests/bugs/SL-069-EveryCaseFollowsCounts.Tests.ps1 -Shape ExpectFactsMismatch` exits 0 at ff666b0 in 148 s. It feeds in N=11 and N+1=12 Facts. C-005 passes N+1, and each copy prints 'found N … has N+1' with exit 2 CANNOT-READ under powershell.exe and pwsh.

Still present at ff666b0. On a scratch copy with an import rule written `name: >` (folded, clip), the engine reads the name with a trailing '\n' and the harness prints '…Core' followed by CR LF. C-007 exits 1 on pwsh and powershell.exe with 'unnamed: the provider's folded-with-newline probe never imports Core'. It is latent: the real yaml's only import rule has a plain name, and C-007 on the real tree exits 0. It is owed to build-slice as recorded; I did not fix it. It is the fifth finding on the same comparison, and the structural close (harness emits a JSON list, C-007 compares lists) would retire the class.

On my own scratch copy (not the builder's shape), C-007 names import rules spelt with é and with an em dash on both hosts. The harness prints caf\xe9 and —, and Get-ImportRuleNames now produces the same escapes. The builder's ImportRuleNames shape also exits 0 with 9 rules named.
The engine's exit 0 is on record. The repro file is not in the 9dad96a..ff666b0 diff. At HEAD the recount it depends on still holds: SingleScope is green at 12/16/28 on both hosts.

not_reached: A real future slice that declares a twinned rule through the engine's own flow. Only scratch copies (SingleScope, TwoScope, EngineCases) were run, so whether the next twinned slice leaves RuleCases.ps1 untouched is still unknown until one lands.
A real import rule whose name is non-ASCII, wrapped, commented, folded or escaped. None exists in the yaml, so the O-028 fix and the O-029 defect were measured only on scratch copies.
The acceptance repro was not re-run, by design. Its exit 0 is the engine's measurement (O-001).

SL-071's own behaviour (the scanner and volume-space changes) was exercised only through the 394-test Core.Tests run, the rules harness and C-007's Scanner.cs bite. The published exe and a real drive scan were not run here; they belong to SL-071's own validate.
Build 6's own mutant (encode removed) was not reproduced here; it rests on the builder's record plus my independent O-028 scratch run.
